data.name: Padmapriya
data.gender_notes: Padmapriya is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Padma (lotus) represents purity, knowledge, and enlightenment. Priya means love. Thus, Padmapriya signifies the love for knowledge, purity, and enlightenment. The name Padmapriya carries the meaning “Lotus Love” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Padmapriya usually hope their child will grow to embody lotus love and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who embodies the love for knowledge and enlightenment.
data.etymology: Padmapriya belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lotus Love.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Padmapriya total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_sanskrit.name: पद्मप्रिया
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: पद्म् (Padma) - lotus, प्रिया (Priya) - dear, loving So, Padmapriya means 'Loving Goddess Padma (Lotus)'.

in_hindi.name: पद्मप्रिया
in_hindi.long_meaning: पद्म (Padma) - कमल (Lotus), प्रिया (Priya) - प्यारी (Beloved, Dear, Loving) So, Padmapriya in Hindi means 'Beloved Lotus'.

in_tamil.name: பத்மப்ரியா
in_tamil.long_meaning: பத்மம் (Padamam) - கமலம் (Lotus), பிரியா (Priya) - வளர்ந்து வரும் வந்திருக்கின்ற ஒன்பது (Beloved, Dear, Loving) So, Padmapriya in Tamil means 'Beloved Lotus'.

in_telugu.name: పద్మప్రియా
in_telugu.long_meaning: పద్మ (Padma) - కెయ్యెడు (Lotus), ప్రియా (Priya) - ప్యారే (Beloved, Dear, Loving) So, Padmapriya in Telugu means 'Beloved Lotus'.

data.cultural_impact: The name Padmapriya holds significant value in Hindu culture, where the Padma symbol is revered. Lotus flowers are commonly used in religious rituals, art, and architecture due to their pure white color, fragrance, and significant connection to various Hindu deities, particularly Lakshmi, Saraswati, and Vishnu. The name Padmapriya connects the person to this rich cultural heritage and ideals of knowledge, purity, and spiritual growth.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Padmapriya has deep spiritual significance. The lotus symbolizes detachment, creation, purity, and rebirth. In Hinduism, the lotus is often associated with the divine, representing the spiritual potential that lies within all us. Padmapriya may be seen as a reminder to constant self-improvement, seek knowledge, maintain purity in thoughts and actions, and eventually achieve spiritual enlightenment.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Padmapriya means 'Beloved of Lotus'. The name signifies purity, grace, and divine attachment, reflecting the inner spiritual qualities of a devoted soul. The lotus symbolizes enlightenment, detachment, and the ability to thrive in both the material and spiritual worlds.

historical_references.reference: Padmapriya was a celebrated dancer in the royal courts of the Chola dynasty in the late 10th and early 11th centuries. She was renowned for her exquisite dance performances, which were often depicted in temple carvings and inscriptions.
historical_references.context: Chola Dynasty, India, Temple Carvings and Inscriptions

historical_references.reference: Padmapriya was a legendary figure in ancient Hindu texts, described as a beautiful and virtuous woman who was the consort of the god Vishnu in his avatar as Krishna. She is often depicted in Hindu mythology as the embodiment of love and devotion.
historical_references.context: Hindu Mythology, God Vishnu, Avatar Krishna
